1.content: Tile types: S = start location of the agent; F = free, traversable tile with no immediate reward (episode continues); H = hazard tile (entering ends episode with failure); G = goal tile (entering yields a positive reward and terminates the episode).

6.content: Single-step lookahead values can be misleading because they assume deterministic outcomes; with high stochasticity and limited samples, estimated values have high variance, often favoring actions that yield little actual progress.

7.content: Attempting to move off the grid (outside the map bounds) results in the agent remaining on its current tile.

8.content: Each movement action stochastically results in one of five outcomes—intended direction, opposite direction, a perpendicular direction (left or right), or no movement—with approximately equal probability.
